name: How long does a typical bathroom refresh take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom refresh take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom refresh depends on the scope of work. A minor refresh involving only painting, new light fixtures, and mirror replacement might take 3-5 days. If the project includes replacing a vanity, toilet, and re-tiling a small area, it could extend to 1-2 weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical bathroom refresh can take from 3-5 days for minor updates up to 1-2 weeks for more extensive work.
